# Swagger UI assets

This directory contains the unmodified Swagger UI 5.34.1 distribution CSS and JavaScript bundle from the official `swagger-ui-dist` npm package.

- Package: `swagger-ui-dist@5.34.1`
- Source: https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui/tree/v5.34.1
- Runtime: served locally by the application; no CDN or third-party runtime request is used
- License: Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`
- Bundled dependency notices: `swagger-ui-bundle.js.LICENSE.txt`

When updating these files, update this provenance note and the corresponding third-party license entry in the project `LICENSE.md` in the same change.
